notes.title: Setting materials and art books will be distributed at Comic Market 105 (C105)
notes.notes:
Coming Comic Market 105 (C105) 2nd day 12/30 Monday We will be distributing the setting material collection (already published) and art book (new publication) for this game "Causality Inside The Memory" at West Hall 2 "Ke" Block-07b .

↓Space placement position
https://webcatalog.circle.ms/Circle/Map/20003044/1 

[url=「因果律 Inside THe Memory」設定資料集表紙][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44869440/7fdd9c5613077320240fe0054777378640047386.png[/img][/url]

[url=因果律 Inside The Memory 画集][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44869440/95a3d11dad83d20c530d6d8af5bbca967f9bfb92.png[/img][/url]

Thanks to you, Steam's Lifetime total units (number of users with library) are over 13,000!
``Causality Inside The Memory'' is an almost fully voiced mystery novel game that uses Live2D to move with rich expression.

The setting material collection covers everything from character settings to facial expressions and poses. Some stills and background images used during the game are also posted. Furthermore, the chronology of the novel that connects the game and the world view is also fully revealed! There is also a QR code on the page where you can listen to samples of CVs! You can understand everything about "Causality Inside The Memory" with this one book!

The art book was created from scratch based on the world view in the game. A worldview that can only be enjoyed through this book. Please enjoy it.

Please come visit our booth on the day. We look forward to seeing you!
